beats.label: S1 · The midnight call
beats.text: Rose Larkin calls a hotline that reaches FBI agent Peter Sutherland after her aunt and uncle are murdered; he takes her into protective custody.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the two leads and the Night Action premise the whole series turns on.

beats.label: S1 · The Campbells' warning
beats.text: Rose reveals her aunt said someone in the White House can't be trusted; a hidden hard drive points Peter to defense contractor Turn Lake Industries.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the mole hunt and the villain corporation that drive the rest of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Farr is the mole
beats.text: Peter realises Chief of Staff Diane Farr is the mole and narrowly escapes the White House, becoming a fugitive hunted by his own government.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Peter from insider to outlaw and locks in the season's central betrayal.

beats.label: S1 · Maddie kidnapped
beats.text: VP Redfield's daughter Maddie is taken by the Metro bomber; Secret Service agents Arrington and Monks hunt for her while Peter is falsely blamed for the abduction.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the Arrington/Monks strand that eventually converges with Peter and Rose at the climax.

beats.label: S1 · The conspiracy revealed
beats.text: Peter and Rose piece together that VP Redfield, Farr and Turn Lake's Gordon Wick orchestrated the Metro bombing to kill Balkan leader Omar Zadar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the full conspiracy and its motive, which sets up the Camp David endgame.

beats.label: S1 · Camp David saved
beats.text: Peter stops a bomb on Marine One seconds before President Travers boards; Farr is captured, Redfield arrested and Maddie agrees to testify against her father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the S1 threat and clears the political board of Farr/Redfield/Wick.

beats.label: S1 · Recruited as Night Agent
beats.text: Travers tells Peter his late father was preparing to turn double agent when he was killed, then recruits Peter as a full Night Agent for his first mission.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pure S2 launchpad: reframes Peter's father and moves Peter from White House desk to field agent.

cliffhanger.text: Peter is departing on his first mission as a full Night Agent, now in a relationship with Rose and finally holding proof his father died before he could turn.
questions: What will Peter's first field assignment demand of him?
Can his relationship with Rose survive life as a Night Agent?
How deep did the Turn Lake conspiracy really reach beyond the three arrested?

characters.name: Peter Sutherland
characters.line: FBI agent who once stopped a DC Metro bombing; now recruited as a full Night Agent, dating Rose, and cleared of inheriting his father's suspected guilt.

characters.name: Rose Larkin
characters.line: Cybersecurity expert whose murdered aunt and uncle pulled her into Night Action; survived the conspiracy and is now with Peter.

characters.name: President Michelle Travers
characters.line: POTUS whose life Peter saved at Camp David; revealed the truth about Peter's father and brought him into the program.

characters.name: Diane Farr
characters.line: White House Chief of Staff and the traitor at the centre of the plot; captured alive to stand trial.

characters.name: Ashley Redfield
characters.line: Vice President who ordered the Metro bombing to kill Omar Zadar; arrested after his own daughter agreed to testify.

characters.name: Gordon Wick
characters.line: CEO of defence contractor Turn Lake Industries, the conspiracy's money and muscle.

characters.name: Chelsea Arrington
characters.line: Secret Service agent who protected Maddie Redfield and helped Peter expose the plot from inside the detail.

beats.label: S2 · Alice dies in Bangkok
beats.text: Ten months later, Peter's Night Action partner Alice Leeds is killed on a Bangkok op; suspecting an internal leak, he goes AWOL and off-grid.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Peter's paranoia about Night Action itself and pulls Rose back into his orbit.

beats.label: S2 · Rose tracks him down
beats.text: Rose, now at AI firm AdVerse, uses her tech to find Peter in New York; they reunite just as broker Jacob Monroe's gunman Solomon closes in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the leads and introduces Monroe, the season's real antagonist and the launchpad into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Foxglove surfaces
beats.text: Peter's handler Catherine Weaver assigns him to Iranian defector Noor Taheri, whose intel exposes Monroe brokering the chemical weapon Foxglove to hostile clients.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the McGuffin (Foxglove/KX) and installs Catherine as Peter's new mentor.

beats.label: S2 · The Bala plot
beats.text: Imprisoned dictator Viktor Bala directs his son Tomás and nephew Markus to steal Foxglove chemicals and plan a retaliatory KX attack on America.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Identifies who is actually going to attack and why, framing the ticking-clock half of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Markus kills Tomás
beats.text: When Tomás loses his nerve, Markus murders him with the weapon and takes command; Rose is captured while posing as a chemist helping the crew.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the one Bala with second thoughts, guaranteeing the attack goes ahead, and puts Rose in mortal danger.

beats.label: S2 · UN attack thwarted
beats.text: Peter and Catherine trace Markus to UN Headquarters and stop the KX release; Markus is killed, Rose is rescued and Solomon is executed by Catherine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Bala/Foxglove arc so nothing but Monroe carries into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Hagan wins via Monroe
beats.text: Monroe leaks intel that hands isolationist Richard Hagan the presidency; Catherine releases Peter to serve as a double agent, waiting for Monroe's call.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The entire S3 setup: Monroe now owns the White House and Peter is planted against him.

cliffhanger.text: Peter is free but planted as a double agent against Jacob Monroe, who now effectively owns the incoming US President. He and Rose have agreed they cannot risk being together.
questions: When Monroe finally calls, what will he demand of Peter?
How far does Monroe's leverage over President-elect Hagan reach?
Can Peter and Rose stay apart with the walls closing in?

characters.name: Peter Sutherland
characters.line: Night Agent whose Bangkok partner was killed; released from arrest to work Monroe as a double agent for Catherine.

characters.name: Rose Larkin
characters.line: Cybersecurity chief at AdVerse; helped foil the KX plot and agreed with Peter they can't be together for now.

characters.name: Catherine Weaver
characters.line: Peter's handler and an old associate of his father; running the double-agent play against Monroe.

characters.name: Jacob Monroe
characters.line: Cold, cancer-stricken secrets broker who now effectively owns the new US President.

characters.name: Richard Hagan
characters.line: Kansas governor turned President-elect, elevated by intel Monroe fed him years earlier.

beats.label: S3 · Pima 12 downed
beats.text: A year later, Flight Pima 12 is shot down over Venezuela by terror group LFS; Peter tracks FinCEN whistleblower Jay Batra to Istanbul.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the attack, the investigation and Batra, whose intel drives the whole season.

beats.label: S3 · Catherine killed
beats.text: Monroe finally calls, luring Catherine into a car bomb during Batra's handover; Peter is left broken and forced into blind obedience to Monroe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Peter's mentor and locks him into Monroe's leash — the shape of the entire rest of the season.

beats.label: S3 · Isabel's investigation
beats.text: Journalist Isabel De Leon traces LFS funding to shell companies orbiting the Hagans; Peter saves her from an assassin known only as the Father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Isabel and the Father, both essential to the finale and beyond.

beats.label: S3 · Arrington set up
beats.text: Chelsea Arrington, now on the presidential detail, is manipulated by First Lady Jenny Hagan into fatally shooting unarmed White House butler Brian Mott.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Arrington on the trail of Jenny and marks her as a target the Hagans will try to bury.

beats.label: S3 · Monroe is Isabel's father
beats.text: Isabel discovers Monroe is her estranged father; Peter and new partner Adam Corrigan rescue him in exchange for a fairy-tale cipher to his intel database.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Realigns Monroe from villain to reluctant asset and hands the team the evidence trove that ends the season.

beats.label: S3 · Adam kills Monroe
beats.text: On a secret order from Hagan, Adam shoots Monroe and stages it as suicide; Peter realises the President is using Adam to bury his ties to the broker.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals Adam's compromise and confirms Hagan as the ultimate antagonist — sets the finale's fight.

beats.label: S3 · Hagan pardons himself
beats.text: Isabel livestreams the evidence exposing the Hagans, but weeks later the President pardons himself and Jenny; the Father slips away and poisons Freya Myers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The state Peter wakes up in for the next season: exposed enemies untouchable, and the Father still killing on his own terms.

cliffhanger.text: The Hagans have escaped legal consequence via self-pardon, the Father has walked away with his son but is still killing to tidy loose ends, and Peter is preparing to head back into the field with a new partner assigned by Mosley.
questions: Can the Hagans really be untouchable now that they've pardoned themselves?
Who is the "good partner" Mosley has lined up for Peter?
What does the Father do next now that he's chosen to disappear with his son?

characters.name: Peter Sutherland
characters.line: Night Agent whose mentor Catherine was killed by Monroe; exposed Hagan but watched him walk free, now awaiting a new partner from Mosley.

characters.name: Isabel De Leon
characters.line: Investigative journalist and Monroe's estranged daughter; published the livestreamed exposé that named the Hagans.

characters.name: Richard Hagan
characters.line: Sitting US President; pardoned himself and Jenny after his ties to Monroe and the LFS attack were exposed.

characters.name: Jenny Hagan
characters.line: First Lady who laundered Monroe's illegal donation through her charity; pardoned alongside her husband.

characters.name: Adam Corrigan
characters.line: Peter's second Night Action partner and Hagan's plant; shot Monroe on order before Peter turned him against the President.

characters.name: Chelsea Arrington
characters.line: Presidential detail agent manipulated into killing an unarmed man; sidelined on disciplinary leave before helping Peter finish the job.

characters.name: The Father
characters.line: Deniable assassin behind the season's killings; walked away with his young son and poisoned Freya Myers on his way out.

characters.name: Jay Batra
characters.line: FinCEN analyst whose leaked SARs cracked the case; helped decrypt Monroe's cipher database that took down the Hagans.

characters.name: Jacob Monroe
characters.line: Secrets broker who orchestrated Hagan's rise and turned out to be Isabel's father; killed by Adam on the President's order.

characters.name: Mosley
characters.line: Peter's superior after Catherine's death; promises to assign him a good partner going forward.
